Definition: from G3056; rational ("logical"):--reasonable, of the word.
BiblicalUsage: logikós means reasonable, of the word, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Romans 12:1, "[which is] your reasonable service."; and in 1 Peter 2:2, "desire the sincere milk of the word".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe reasonable service is the milk of the word — newborn babes desiring it, and living sacrifices offering it.
RelatedTopics: Growth; True Worship; Word of God
